weekly.AM: Back dock cleaned, organized, and sprayed off
All walls in the prep area and down the hallway to dry storage cleaned
weekly.PM: All walls in dish area and walls on equipment side of the line cleaned

weekly.AM: Detail and organize all the expo windows (shelves & top) and wipe down KDS screens
Detail entire dish area (machine / walls / floor / pipes)
weekly.PM: All trash cans detailed with bleach

weekly.AM: All prep tables detailed (tops / shelves / legs) and setup side of the line walls detailed
weekly.PM: Empty and detail all setup coolers on line & stand-up freezer (make sure all baskets are cleaned)

weekly.AM: Dry storage floor detailed, swept, and mopped
weekly.PM: Walk-in freezer and cooler shelves & floors detailed, swept and mopped — use antifreeze on the freezer floor
weekly.note: Detail shelves means organize product, discard all possible boxes, and wipe the shelves.

weekly.AM: Bun drawer pulled out and detailed. Detail all tables online
weekly.PM: All sinks and drains cleaned / bleached (prep, hand, 3-compartment and dish sinks, and every drain in the BOH)

monthly.title: Ice machine
monthly.AM: Turn off first thing and clean outside of machine
monthly.PM: Burn ice and clean inside the machine with the hose

monthly.title: Flour bins
monthly.PM: Rotate and clean all flour bins

monthly.title: Speed racks
monthly.AM: Detail all speed racks — take them out back, spray them with grease strip, let that sit about 5 minutes, then spray off with hot water
